intro: Nigeria is a federal presidential republic of 36 states.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years, up to two terms; Bola Tinubu took office in 2023. The National Assembly has a Senate and a House of Representatives. Abuja replaced Lagos as capital in 1991.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Insecurity in the north, kidnappings and corruption are major problems. In 2020 young people led the #EndSARS protests against police brutality.

keyTerms.meaning: Power shared between national and state governments.

items.title: The President
items.text: Signs it, or vetoes it; a two-thirds vote can override.
